prompt: The brake-actuator supply program is tracked as litigation case litigation_cases_001. Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): minimum_commitment, volume_restriction, price_restrictions, rofr_rofo_rofn, most_favored_nation. For each category present, file one record with litigation_cases_evidence_create for litigation_cases_001. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
